freeze_for_dedup: freeze a torch tensor or nested container into a hashable fingerprint fragment for deduplication
clone_tensor_tree: recursively clone all torch tensors inside a nested list, tuple, or dict tree
group_requests_by_fingerprint: group a list of request objects by a custom fingerprint function while preserving order
copy_stage_output: shallow copy a reusable container like list, tuple, or dict while preserving tensor references
run_deduplicated_group: run a pipeline stage once per unique fingerprint and copy outputs to duplicate requests
